reason: A better addresses the stated HEA bottleneck by testing both solid and liquid free energies in an actual multicomponent alloy and defines comparative cost and fidelity thresholds, whereas B confines validation to elemental/binary systems and leaves the central HEA extension untested. A is still weakened by absent supporting citations and by not clearly explaining how a conventional MLP explicitly retains electronic-temperature/electron–vibration contributions rather than merely fitting ionic Born–Oppenheimer energies.
